set -euo pipefail
OUT=/work/report.md
LOGDIR=/work/logs

  printf "Directory %s not found.\n" "$LOGDIR" >> "$OUT"

# Find files modified in last 24 hours

  exit 0

printf "\n" >> "$OUT"
# Extract error lines
ERRS=$(grep -iE "error|failed|exception|traceback" $FILES -n --line-buffered || true)
if [ -z "$ERRS" ]; then
  printf "No lines matching error/failed/exception/traceback found in the last 24 hours.\n" >> "$OUT"
  echo "No error lines" >&2
  exit 0
fi
# Save raw error lines to a temp file
TMPERR=$(mktemp)
printf "%s\n" "$ERRS" > "$TMPERR"
# Show top exact lines
printf "Distinct exact error lines (top 50 by frequency):\n" >> "$OUT"
sort "$TMPERR" | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 50 >> "$OUT"
printf "\n" >> "$OUT"
# Normalize lines: remove common timestamps, IPs, numbers, hex ids
TMPN=$(mktemp)
cat "$TMPERR" \
  | sed -E "s/^([^:]+):[0-9]+://" \
  | sed -E "s/\[[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[^]]*\]//g" \
  | sed -E "s/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}([ T])[0-9:.-]+//g" \
  | sed -E "s/[0-9]+/<NUM>/g" \
  | sed -E "s/[0-9a-fA-F]{8,}/<HEX>/g" \
  | sed -E "s/([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/<IP>/g" \
  | sed -E "s/\s+/ /g" \
  | sed -E "s/^\s+|\s+$//g" \
  > "$TMPN"
printf "Normalized error categories (top 50 by frequency):\n" >> "$OUT"
sort "$TMPN" | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 50 >> "$OUT"
printf "\n" >> "$OUT"
# Hourly distribution: try ISO-style date-hour first
TMPH=$(mktemp)
cat "$TMPERR" \
  | grep -oP "\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}[ T]\d{2}" || true \
  > "$TMPH"
if [ -s "$TMPH" ]; then
  printf "Hourly distribution (ISO date-hour counts):\n" >> "$OUT"
  sort "$TMPH" | uniq -c | sort -rn >> "$OUT"
  printf "\n" >> "$OUT"
else
  # try Apache style date with hour
  cat "$TMPERR" | grep -oP "\d{2}/[A-Za-z]{3}/\d{4}:[0-9]{2}" > "$TMPH" || true
  if [ -s "$TMPH" ]; then
    printf "Hourly distribution (Apache-style date-hour counts):\n" >> "$OUT"
    sort "$TMPH" | uniq -c | sort -rn >> "$OUT"
    printf "\n" >> "$OUT"
  else
    printf "Could not extract reliable hours from timestamps in error lines.\n\n" >> "$OUT"
  fi
fi
# Summarize top categories into bullet points
printf "Summary of distinct error categories (approx counts and notes):\n" >> "$OUT"
# Take top 10 normalized categories and put brief notes
sort "$TMPN" | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 10 | awk '{cnt=$1; $1=""; sub(/^ /,""); msg=$0; if(length(msg)>120) msg=substr(msg,1,120) "..."; printf "- %s occurrences: %s\n", cnt, msg }' >> "$OUT"
printf "\n" >> "$OUT"
# Clean up
rm -f "$TMPERR" "$TMPN" "$TMPH"
printf "End of report.\n" >> "$OUT"

# Print location
echo "Wrote report to $OUT"
'
